mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base b LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_stock gs on b.goods_id = gs.goods_id WHERE gs.goods_stock > 0 AND b.goods_is_shelves = 1 and b.common_id = #{commomId}

SELECT b.goods_id as goodsId, b.common_id as commonId FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base b LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_stock gs on b.goods_id = gs.goods_id WHERE gs.goods_stock = 0 AND b.goods_is_shelves = 1
